dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin with, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 30代女です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: お返事ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, what brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 8年付き合った彼氏と別れました…結婚すると思っていたのに
dialogue.English: I broke up with my boyfriend of eight years... I thought we were going to get married.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もう嫌です、彼が私の全てだったのに
dialogue.English: I can't take it anymore. He was my everything.

dialogue.content: 辛い事でしたね・・・
dialogue.English: That must have been so painful...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 彼が大好きだったんですね・・・
dialogue.English: You really loved him, didn't you...

dialogue.content: はい、今でも好きです結婚すると思って今まで尽くしてたのに、捨てられました
dialogue.English: Yes, I still love him. I devoted myself to him all this time thinking we would get married, but he just threw me away.

dialogue.content: それはあんまりですね。
dialogue.English: That's just awful.

dialogue.content: もうすぐ40歳になるのに…これからひとりでどうやって生きていけばいいのか分かりません
dialogue.English: I'm almost 40... I don't know how I'm going to live on my own from now on.

dialogue.content: 信じてたのに…もうなにもかも嫌です
dialogue.English: I trusted him... I'm sick of everything now.

dialogue.content: 仕事も休んでます…
dialogue.English: I've even been taking time off work...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 気力もすっかりなくなってしまっているんですね・・・
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've completely lost all your energy...

dialogue.content: 生きる気力もないです生きてる意味もなくなりました
dialogue.English: I don't have the will to live. There's no meaning to my life anymore.

dialogue.content: そういうお気持ちになっているんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.content: 本当にどん底にいるような感じでしょうね・・・
dialogue.English: You must feel like you've truly hit rock bottom...

dialogue.content: だって捨てられたんですよ価値がないってことですよね…
dialogue.English: Because he threw me away. That means I'm worthless, right...?

dialogue.content: もうすぐ40歳で、また恋人ができるとも思えない
dialogue.English: I'm almost 40, and I can't imagine finding another partner.

dialogue.content: あの人よりいい人が見つかるとは思えない
dialogue.English: I don't think I'll ever find someone better than him.

dialogue.content: 彼とのことがとっても大きかったんですね・・・
dialogue.English: Your relationship with him was such a huge part of your life...

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ヨリを戻せるなら戻したいです
dialogue.English: If I could get back together with him, I would.

dialogue.content: そういうお気持ちなんですね。彼とのこと、いきさつを話していただけますか？
dialogue.English: That's how you feel. Would you be willing to tell me how things unfolded with him?

dialogue.content: 前の職場で事務職をしていたんですが、そこに営業マンとして来ていたのか彼でした
dialogue.English: I used to work as an office clerk at my previous job, and he was a salesman who would visit.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 爽やかで仕事もできて、結構社内の女の子たちもファンがいて、
dialogue.English: He was charming, good at his job, and had quite a few fans among the women in the office.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな憧れの的みたいな彼から、ある日食事に誘われたのがきっかけでお付き合いするようになりました
dialogue.English: He was someone everyone admired, and one day he asked me out to dinner. That's how we started dating.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。彼から声がかかったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So he was the one who approached you.

dialogue.content: ステキでしたね。
dialogue.English: That must have been wonderful.

dialogue.content: お付き合いが始まっても、とても優しくて格好良くて、私なんかに勿体ないって思うほど素敵な人で、
dialogue.English: Even after we started dating, he was so kind and handsome. He was such a wonderful person that I felt he was too good for someone like me.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: いつか結婚できたらいいねって、お互い話も出てたんです
dialogue.English: We had even talked about how it would be nice to get married someday.

dialogue.content: そこまでお話しが出ていたのですね。
dialogue.English: So your conversations had gone that far.

dialogue.content: でも、半年前くらいから連絡がつかない日が増えてきて
dialogue.English: But starting about six months ago, the days when I couldn't reach him started to increase.

dialogue.content: 様子が変わってきた・・・
dialogue.English: Things started to change...

dialogue.content: 仕事が忙しくなったって言われて、仕事がデキル彼の邪魔をしないように連絡を我慢してて、
dialogue.English: He told me work had gotten busy, so I held back from contacting him so I wouldn't get in the way of his work, since he's so capable.

dialogue.content: そこは配慮したんですね。
dialogue.English: So you were being considerate.

dialogue.content: たまに、1〜2時間時間が空いたって急に連絡が入って、
dialogue.English: Occasionally, he'd suddenly contact me, saying he had an hour or two free,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 短時間でも会えるのが嬉しくて嬉しくて…
dialogue.English: and I was just so, so happy to see him, even for a short time...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: That's understandable.

dialogue.content: 仕事が落ち着くまで我慢しようって、信じてたんです
dialogue.English: I trusted him and told myself I'd just have to be patient until his work settled down.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ある日、私の部屋に女の子が訪ねてきました
dialogue.English: One day, a young woman showed up at my apartment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 突然ですね・・・
dialogue.English: That was sudden...

dialogue.content: その女の子が言うんですよ、彼の本命は私だから、アンタ彼と別れてあげてよって
dialogue.English: And she said to me, 'I'm his real girlfriend, so you need to break up with him.'

dialogue.content: 何ということを・・・
dialogue.English: What a thing to say...

dialogue.content: はい、突然でなんのことがサッパリ理解できないし、そもそもなんで私の家を知ってるの？とか、パニックになりました
dialogue.English: Yes, it was so sudden that I couldn't understand what was happening at all. And how did she even know where I live? I panicked.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Of course you would.

dialogue.content: 彼女に対して、あなたは何て言ったのですか？
dialogue.English: What did you say to her?

dialogue.content: 私は、結婚の話も出ているし本命は私の方だよって言いました
dialogue.English: I told her that we had even talked about getting married, so I was the real one.

dialogue.content: でも、またその女の子が言うんですよ、
dialogue.English: But then, she said again,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼がオバサンにつきまとわれて困ってるって言ってるって
dialogue.English: that he told her he was having trouble with an 'old lady' who was clinging to him.

dialogue.content: なんということを。失礼な。
dialogue.English: What a thing to say. How rude.

dialogue.content: 私、その場で彼に電話したんですよ
dialogue.English: I called him right then and there.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうしたら？
dialogue.English: And then?

dialogue.content: 今、本命だって言ってる女の子が私の家に来てるんだけど、どういう事って
dialogue.English: I said, 'There's a girl at my apartment right now who says she's your real girlfriend. What is going on?'

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: よく言いましたね。
dialogue.English: Good for you for saying that.

dialogue.content: でも、彼は私にごめんごめんって繰り返すばっかりで…
dialogue.English: But he just kept repeating, 'I'm sorry, I'm sorry'...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その他には？
dialogue.English: Anything else?

dialogue.content: 本当にその女の子と付き合ってて、私とは別れようと思ってたけど言えなかったって…言われました
dialogue.English: He told me... that he really was dating that girl, and that he'd been wanting to break up with me but couldn't bring himself to say it.

dialogue.content: なんど。
dialogue.English: Oh, no.

dialogue.content: そんなひどい事を。
dialogue.English: How could he do something so cruel?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: やっぱり若い子がいいって、言われました
dialogue.English: He told me he preferred younger women after all.

dialogue.content: 彼はそんなこと言ったのですね。
dialogue.English: He really said that to you.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: だったらもっと早く、8年も引っ張らないで欲しかった
dialogue.English: If that's the case, I wish he had told me sooner, instead of stringing me along for eight years.

dialogue.content: 8年、長いお付き合いでしたね・・・
dialogue.English: Eight years... that was a long relationship.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: その電話の後は、彼とは会ったことは？
dialogue.English: After that phone call, did you see him again?

dialogue.content: 私の部屋に、彼の荷物があったので、それを取りにきてもらいましたそれが、最後です
dialogue.English: He had some of his things at my apartment, so I had him come pick them up. That was the last time.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その時に彼は何か言っていましたか？
dialogue.English: Did he say anything then?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 彼が荷物を取りに来たのはどのくらい前のことですか？
dialogue.English: How long ago did he come to pick up his things?

dialogue.content: 一週間ほど前です
dialogue.English: About a week ago.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それからすっかり、もぬけの殻のようになってしまったのですね。
dialogue.English: And since then, you've been feeling completely empty, like a hollow shell.

dialogue.content: そうですね…私は価値もない人間なんだなって、思い知らされました
dialogue.English: Yes... It made me realize that I'm a worthless person.

dialogue.content: 彼が生きがいだったんですものね・・・
dialogue.English: He was your reason for living, wasn't he...

dialogue.content: はい、それに、私ともし結婚したとして、
dialogue.English: Yes, and on top of that, if we were to get married,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子どもを作ろうってなったとき、40近い女だと障害のある赤ちゃんが生まれる確率高くなるだろって言われました
dialogue.English: he told me that if we decided to have children, the chances of having a baby with a disability would be higher with a woman approaching 40.

dialogue.content: そんなことまで言われたのですか。
dialogue.English: He even said that to you?

dialogue.content: それはショックだったでしょうね。
dialogue.English: That must have been a terrible shock.

dialogue.content: はい…ショックでしたねそこまで言わなくてもね
dialogue.English: Yes... it was a shock. He didn't have to go that far.

dialogue.content: そうですよ。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: でも、それでもまだ好きでヨリを戻せるなら戻したいって思う私も、おかしいですよね
dialogue.English: But even so, I still love him and want to get back together with him if I can. That's strange, isn't it?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: なんかもう、彼も殺して私も死にたい
dialogue.English: I just... I want to kill him and then kill myself.

dialogue.content: あなたの中に、彼に対する深くて熱い思いがあるってことだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I think it shows that you have deep and passionate feelings for him.

dialogue.content: これからどうしていけばいいのか、分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do from now on.

dialogue.content: そんなに深く彼を愛していたということですよね。
dialogue.English: It means you loved him that deeply, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 今は途方に暮れて、何も考えられないんですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Right now you're at a complete loss, and you can't think about anything...

dialogue.content: もう、分からないです…
dialogue.English: I just don't know anymore...

dialogue.content: 生きててもしょうがない
dialogue.English: There's no point in living.

dialogue.content: 一つだけ確かなことは、あなたが一人の人を8年間かけて大切にして、愛してきたっていうことは事実だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: One thing is certain: it's a fact that you cherished and loved one person for eight years.

dialogue.content: 私の全てがなくなって、これからひとりで生きていけると思えない
dialogue.English: My everything is gone. I can't imagine living on my own from now on.

dialogue.content: 今は、とっても大切なものを失ってしまっただけに、そのショックがあまりにも大きいのですね・・・
dialogue.English: Right now, because you've lost something so precious, the shock is just too immense...

dialogue.content: はい…捨てられたくせに、まだ好きな気持ちがある自分も嫌です
dialogue.English: Yes... I hate myself for still having feelings for him, even though he threw me away.

dialogue.content: あなたには、人を信じて、大切にして、愛する力があるということだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I think it shows that you have the ability to trust, cherish, and love someone.

dialogue.content: それは、あなたのかけがえのない価値です。
dialogue.English: That is your irreplaceable value.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 今は、とてもつらいけれど。
dialogue.English: I know it's very painful right now, but...

dialogue.content: 心の中にとても深い傷ができているのですよね。
dialogue.English: You have a very deep wound in your heart, don't you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その傷が耐えられないほどに痛んでいるんですよね。
dialogue.English: And that wound is hurting so much it's unbearable, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは彼をとても深く愛し、信じていただけに、その傷が癒えるにはかなり時間がかかるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Because you loved and trusted him so deeply, it may take a considerable amount of time for that wound to heal.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもきっとその傷が癒える日が来ると思いますよ。
dialogue.English: But I am sure the day will come when that wound heals.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無理をせず、静かに時を待ってみてはいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: How about not pushing yourself, and just waiting quietly for a while?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: たった一つだけ、確かなことは、あなたには本気で人を愛する力があるということです。
dialogue.English: There is one thing that's certain: you have the ability to love someone wholeheartedly.

dialogue.content: それは、あなたの限りない価値だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I believe that is your limitless worth.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: ご自身を信じてあげてください。
dialogue.English: Please believe in yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: しばらくは、深く傷ついてしまったご自分をゆっくりといたわってあげてください。
dialogue.English: For a while, please take your time to gently care for your deeply wounded self.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 急がずにね。
dialogue.English: No need to rush.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ゆっくりと。
dialogue.English: Take it slowly.

dialogue.content: でも、あなたはステキな心を持っている人だ彼、必ず、心が回復してきますよ。
dialogue.English: But, because you're a person with a wonderful heart, your heart will definitely recover.

dialogue.content: ↑「ひとだから」です。
dialogue.English: That was meant to say, 'because you're a person with a wonderful heart.'

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 辛くなったら、またいらしてください。
dialogue.English: If things get tough, please come back anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: その時は、お気持ちを聴かせていただきます。
dialogue.English: When that time comes, I'll be here to listen to how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そして、ご一緒に考えさせてもいただきます。
dialogue.English: And we can think things through together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では、今日は一旦この辺でよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Well then, shall we end our session here for today?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: あなたが生きていくことを応援していますよ。
dialogue.English: I am rooting for you to keep on living.

dialogue.content: では失礼しますね。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now, then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイお疲れさまでした。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work in this role-play.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work. Thank you very much.)
